deadline.value: Funding deadline December 8, 2026 (apply by this date to enter the University funding competition); the final application deadline is later, but too late for most funding.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 25 in each section; this course sets its own English level.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Listening 7.0, Writing 7.0, Reading 6.5, Speaking 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic) Element Score Listening 7.0 Writing 7.0 Reading 6.5 Speaking 7.0 Total 7.0

supervisor.value: No need to contact a supervisor first, but name up to three preferred supervisors; not naming one may hurt the application.
supervisor.quote: Prospective applicants are not expected to contact a supervisor before applying.

funding.value: Considered automatically for STFC and Isaac Newton studentships; funding is competitive.
funding.quote: Applicants will be considered automatically for all scholarship funding, including the STFC Studentships and Isaac Newton Studentship

entry_route.value: The Degree Committee normally requires the equivalent of a UK master's (pass).
entry_route.quote: The Degree Committee for the Faculty of Physics and Chemistry normally requires applicants to have the equivalent of a UK master's (pass).

notes: Applicants specify up to three preferred supervisors. A PhD in Astrophysics at the Cavendish is the Physics record.
